def solve(case):
    # validate
    if not isinstance(case, dict):
        raise ValueError("case must be a dict")
    required = ["word_token_indices", "word_scores", "forced_words", "token_budget"]
    for key in required:
        if key not in case:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing required field: {key}")
    wti = case["word_token_indices"]
    ws = case["word_scores"]
    fw = case["forced_words"]
    budget = case["token_budget"]
    # basic type checks
    if not isinstance(wti, list) or not isinstance(ws, list) or not isinstance(fw, list):
        raise ValueError("Invalid types")
    if len(wti) != len(ws):
        raise ValueError("Mismatched lengths")
    # check forced indices valid
    n = len(wti)
    for idx in fw:
        if not (0 <= idx < n):
            raise ValueError("Forced word index out of range")
    # compute token counts
    token_counts = [len(tokens) for tokens in wti]
    forced_tokens = sum(token_counts[i] for i in fw)
    if forced_tokens > budget:
        raise ValueError("Forced words exceed budget")
    # build list of candidates: (score, index, token_count, tokens)
    candidates = []
    for i in range(n):
        candidates.append((ws[i], i, token_counts[i], wti[i]))
    # forced set
    selected_indices = set(fw)
    remaining_budget = budget - forced_tokens
    # sort non-forced candidates: descending score, then ascending index
    non_forced = [c for c in candidates if c[1] not in selected_indices]
    non_forced.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], x[1]))
    for score, idx, cnt, tokens in non_forced:
        if cnt <= remaining_budget:
            selected_indices.add(idx)
            remaining_budget -= cnt
    # build output
    selected_words = sorted(selected_indices)
    retained_token_indices = []
    for idx in selected_words:
        retained_token_indices.extend(wti[idx])
    tokens_used = sum(token_counts[i] for i in selected_words)
    return {
        "retained_token_indices": retained_token_indices,
        "selected_words": selected_words,
        "tokens_used": tokens_used
    }
